scoring_justification: The checker recomputes deflection values from the identical closed-form analytical model using the public material/geometric parameters and compares each submitted value; thus full T1 recompute is feasible.

outputs.description: Transverse deflection profile for partially covered CPUA (R1=10 mm, R2=8 mm) on radial grid 0-10 mm, for 4 voltages and 2 model variants.
Transverse deflection profile for half-covered CPUA (R1=10 mm, R2=5 mm) on radial grid 0-10 mm, for 4 voltages and 2 model variants.
Central (r=0) deflection summary for both CPUA types, all voltages and models.

output_contract.notes: The checker recomputes the deflection values from the same closed-form formulas and compares each submitted value with an absolute tolerance. The radial grid must be exactly 0–10 mm with step 0.1 mm. The model column must use the exact strings 'with_bonding' and 'without_bonding'.

steps.description: Recompute deflection for partially covered CPUA from formulas and compare each row.
Recompute deflection for half-covered CPUA from formulas and compare each row.
Recompute central deflection for each case and compare; also cross-check against r=0 row in profile files.
